crownConvention: u/R toward the pinned end, v/R downward; the quotation gives the rotation as 0.0498 and is compared with Stabileo's crown ry, which is positive at the limit point.
source: Robert Schmidt (2000), discussion of Nonlinear Buckling and Postbuckling of Cable-Stiffened Prestressed Domes, Journal of Engineering Mechanics 126(12), p. 1308, quoting Table 1 (limit load and crown state at the limit point) of DaDeppo & Schmidt (1975).
